content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Gumroad and Payhip offer convenient platforms for selling digital products, but they charge significant fees, with Gumroad taking 10% of every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee, making it a more attractive option for creators who want to maximize their earnings. Additionally, COREMERCH's sovereign stacks provide creators with full ownership and control over their digital commerce infrastructure, eliminating the risk of platform fees and restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators in restricted countries, Gumroad and Payhip may not be viable options due to payment processing limitations. COREMERCH's solution, on the other hand, utilizes crypto payments, which can be processed from anywhere in the world, making it an ideal choice for creators who need to reach a global audience. With NOWPayments, creators can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing unparalleled flexibility and accessibility.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed and fees associated with each option can significantly impact a creator's bottom line. Gumroad's 10% fee can result in substantial losses, especially for high-volume sellers. In contrast, NOWPayments' 0.5% fee can save creators thousands of dollars per month. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments retains $921, making the latter a much more cost-effective solution.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides creators with full ownership and control over their digital commerce stacks.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators who value flexibility, ownership, and cost-effectiveness, COREMERCH's sovereign stacks offer a superior solution. By leveraging crypto payments and automated delivery, creators can reach a global audience and maximize their earnings. In contrast, platforms like Gumroad and Payhip may be more suitable for creators who prioritize convenience over control and are willing to absorb higher fees. Ultimately, the choice of architecture depends on a creator's specific needs and priorities.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, choose a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and set up a payment processing system with NOWPayments. Then, configure automated delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and finally, test and deploy your stack. With the Complete Builder Kit, you can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to streamline this process and get started quickly.
